title: Squads turn together on the move
summary: Soldiers turn onto the leader’s new route and choose nearby formation positions.
stage: Native Forward+ gameplay at 30 fps, seed 3. Both cameras show the same village road from 23.20 seconds in the street take.
rationale: A continuous, matched shot lets the viewer follow individual soldiers through the change of direction.
source_ref: Edition 49 gameplay baseline at aec37dd with the individual infantry turn changes. Edition 50 adds the squad travel change. Both recordings use the same scene orders.

sources.caption: The road crossing before and after the change.
